en:
<CLT=cltMIND>When I stepped out into the courtyard,
I yelled at the top of my voice.

Keebo! Monokuma!
Please, stop fighting!

We can solve this another way!
One that's best for both of you!
Please, listen to me!

<CLT=cltMIND>My voice reverberated
throughout the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>And after a while...
It's almost dawn, like we agreed...

Have you found what you were looking for? 
Are you ready to do what must be done, Shuichi?
Either way...this is your last chance.

I have no idea what's going on, but messing
with this robot is starting to bore me, so...
I guess I'll hear you out.
So, what is this other way?
A class trial.

We're all going to do a class trial, one
last time!
A class trial!?

...What do you mean? Are you trying to
continue the killing game?

This is no time to mess around! I thought
you were going to end it!
I'm not messing around.
This class trial...will end the killing game!
A class trial...to *end* the killing game?

<CLT=cltMIND>As Keebo spoke, I saw Maki running
over from the school building.

Hey, what do you mean we're going to do
a class trial?
Are you serious...?

That's...how you're going to end
the killing game?

...Everyone's here.
Now let me say this.

We need to stop fighting...
and have one more class trial.

If we reveal the whole truth there,
we can end this killing game.

The killing game will end when the truth is
exposed? Why would you say such a thing?

By the end of the class trial,
that will be clear.

Monokuma...you're the one who
calls these class trials...

But not this time! This time, *we* choose
to call a class trial! One to end them all!

But...why do we need to hold a class trial
when no one has been killed?
...That's what I'd like to say, but...I get it.
What...?

My little shootout with this rundown robot
hasn't been fun for a while now.

And I think it's pretty interesting that you
guys are on board with holding a class trial.

In fact, I welcome your initiative! This turn
of events will make things very interesting!

<CLT=cltMIND>So even in these circumstances, you take the
opportunity to make things interesting...
<CLT=cltMIND>That means this killing game must be—

However, if we're gonna hold a class trial,
I'm gonna hold you guys responsible for it.
Responsible...?

It would be bad if we held a class trial that
didn't reach a satisfying conclusion.

In other words, if the trial doesn't go your way
and ends without the truth being exposed...

Then you all will be held responsible for
staging such a disappointing class trial.
O-Of course!
Puhuhu... I don't doubt your resolve at all.

But are the others okay with it, too? The
responsibility will be shared by all of you...
Th-The responsibility will be...shared?
We've been ready.
I'll trust you. But if you screw this up...
...I'll kill you before Monokuma can.
...Y-Yeah, I believe you.

Y-You're right... There's no point 
freaking out now...

I have friends I can trust!
There's nothing to be scared of!
K-Keebo...

Also, if we're gonna do this class trial, you
gotta take off all that fancy sci-fi gear.

We can't risk you going berserk if the
outcome isn't in your favor...
Take off this gear...

If I remove these armaments now, I will lose
my chance to destroy this academy...

This is...the last chance. The last chance
to not let Monokuma win...
Is this...really alright?
Keebo...please, believe me.
I don't want Monokuma to win.
*We're* going to win.

Our <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL> is going to end
this game of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Do you really think that ending awaits us?
It sounds too good to be true, honestly.
Yes, I do.

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>ending<CLT=typeNORMAL> *is*
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> for us.
...And we can't give up on <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
Keebo...let's trust Shuichi here.
You don't want to die either...right?

We're all friends who can believe 
in each other, aren't we!?

...Very well, I will remove my armaments.
Let's hold this class trial.
Thank you, Keebo.
Puhuhu... Then it's decided.
That's right. Our class trial!

Our final battle! Our <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> will
defeat your <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
Puhuhu...puhuhuhu...
Ah-hahahahaha!
Why are you laughing...?
I-Is he that confident he'll win?
I-It'll be okay! He's probably just bluffing!
Puhuhu... Who can say?

Well, if we're gonna do this class trial, we
should hurry up and head to the trial grounds.

However...I will have the Monokubs strip
that robot of his gear.
...I know.

Everyone else, please proceed to the Shrine
of Judgment and head to the trial grounds.

Puhuhu... I'll go on ahead and begin preparing.
Monokubs, you can take it from here.

Alright then! We're gonna take all this gear
offa this robot!

I'll finish it in seconds cuz I work like
I eat—fast and sloppy!
You shouldn't be proud of being sloppy.
...I'll meet you guys there.
Y-Yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo walked back toward his
lab with the Exisals.
We should go, too...

I can't believe we're having another 
class trial...

I didn't think Monokuma would accept
so easily.

That was too easy... I can't help but
feel a little strange.

He probably agreed to it to stop Keebo from
destroying the academy.
<CLT=cltMIND>Still...it was almost too easy.
<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps Monokuma simply expected this.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it was still much easier
than I imagined it would be.

<CLT=cltMIND>...No sense worrying about that now.
We've come this far, we just have to do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>To end this killing game, we have
to follow his rules one last time...
<CLT=cltMIND>and win this class trial.
We're having another class trial...

But, this will be the final one...
Right?

Yes, that's right.
This will be the final trial.

Maybe he accepted because he couldn't
handle Keebo's destruction anymore...?
...No, that can't be the reason.

Even Keebo said it himself. He'd only be able
to withstand the Exisals' attacks until dawn.

Then, why did Monokuma agree to this
so easily...?

I can't say for sure, but we can't
be distracted by that.
...That's true. No matter what he's plotting...
We're ready to end this killing game, right?
Yes! With this class trial!

We're ready to end this killing game...
Let's go, Shuichi.

I wonder if Keebo is okay. I hope they don't do
anything weird while they're disarming him.

I'm sure they won't. If anything
happened to Keebo right now...

it wouldn't be a fair trial that
Monokuma insists on.
Oh, I see.
Then it's okay. The four of us, and Keebo...

By combining the marks of our friendship...
we can overcome this final class trial!
The four of us and Keebo...

By combining the marks of our friendship...
we can overcome this final class trial!
